department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering
notes: Materials Science and Engineering Major, PhD.

deadline.value: April 15 online submission deadline for Fall admission.
deadline.quote: The online submission deadline is when the initial application must be submitted online, provided the department has no earlier deadline. By the file completion deadline, admission must be granted and all documents required to obtain a student visa must be submitted to the Division of Global Engagement.

gre_general.value: All applicants must submit scores from the general Graduate Record Examination (GRE).
gre_general.quote: All applicants must submit scores from the general Graduate Record Examination (GRE).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in Materials Science.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Funding package details not stated on catalog page.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree in engineering or science with GPA of at least 2.70 required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for admission to the PhD program in materials science and engineering are expected to have completed a bachelor’s degree in an area of engineering or science with a grade-point-average of at least 2.70 out of 4.00 (or 3.00 during the senior year of undergraduate study).
